K04.executed_slice: HumanPilot DLPFC: 33,086 training spots from two donors/eight sections; 14,243 test spots from one donor/four sections; 500 training-selected genes.
K04.resource: Maynard2021 DLPFC HumanPilot; donor-held-out supervised layer transfer
K04.data: Prepared float32 log-normalized expression for 500 training-selected non-mitochondrial genes; no spatial coordinates or images
K04.ground_truth: Curated L1–L6/white-matter annotations with expression and histology assistance; not fully orthogonal molecular truth
K04.recommended_metrics: Section-equal seven-class macro-F1; pooled F1/accuracy secondary
K04.recommended_split: Train Br5292/Br5595, test Br8100; all four adjacent sections remain together
K04.limitations: Only one test donor; four sections are correlated. Curated labels use expression assistance, shared feature selection uses all outer-training spots, and no spatial context is supplied. Supervised transfer is not unsupervised spatial-domain discovery; global best unverified.
K04.review_depth: All12 original count matrices acquired/hashed; author donor metadata and label joins verified; all top500 training-only gene choices and36 spot normalizations independently reproduced; fixed SingleR reference

M01.executed_slice: IBL Dec2019 choice data: all100 source mice, 83 train/17 held-out; 7,696/1,842 nonoverlapping conditional examples from latest archived sessions.
M01.resource: IBL Dec2019 behavior archive / Figshare11636748; custom mouse-held-out slice
M01.data: Current contrasts/known experimenter block prior plus five past choice/feedback lags;13 features, no current/future response fields
M01.ground_truth: Recorded binary mouse turn choices, not latent cognitive parameter labels
M01.recommended_metrics: Mouse-equal clipped binary negative log-likelihood; pooled loss/accuracy secondary
M01.recommended_split: Hash-split whole mice, latest complete session, first≤1000 trials, disjoint six-trial target/history blocks; nine labs overlap
M01.limitations: Conditional one-step forecast with observed history and known block prior; no autonomous rollout or held-out-lab claim. One historical beta-quality archive; prior target choices never reappear in another scored input. Paper-inspired pooled GLM is not original peranimal fits or established global best.
M01.review_depth: Original CC BY4 archive publisher MD5+localSHA verified; all100 mice and9,538 examples independently matched to source; target/history overlap excluded before scores
